summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Mexican Petroleum (PEMEX), the state-owned oil company, reporting its semi-annual financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing contains an IFRS-based income statement, balance sheet, and equity breakdowns, including segments for certificates of contribution and Mexican government contributions. There are no corporate actions such as acquisitions, divestitures, tenders, or restructuring described. It is a standard periodic disclosure under the 1934 Act required of foreign private issuers, providing operational and financial results without any special-situation event.
